name: Construction execution and the electronic construction log
name_hu: Építőipari kivitelezési tevékenység és az e-építési napló
review_status: Drawn from public statutory sources. Pending review by a Hungarian quantity surveyor before it is relied on for a tender.
references: 191/2009. Korm. rendelet az építőipari kivitelezési tevékenységről
e-építési napló, the state-operated electronic construction log
description: Execution is logged in a state-operated electronic construction log rather than a book on site, and the log is keyed to the itemised bill: progress is recorded against the bill's own lines. A bill whose lines do not survive from tender to execution therefore costs more than tidiness, because the progress record has nothing stable to attach to.
practice_notes: The itemised bill is a required attachment of the execution documentation
Progress claims are made against bill lines, which is the second reason line identity has to hold
The handover chapter of the item order exists because handover documentation is itself a priced deliverable
